caption: The drawing depicts a manual coffee grinder with a wooden rectangular base and a small drawer at the front, featuring a round brass knob. The base sits on an oval platform. On top of the base is a round open bowl, also appearing to be made of wood or possibly metal, attached to a central vertical shaft. Extending from this shaft is a metal crank arm, bent at an angle and ending in a rounded, bulbous handle colored in a brass or bronze tone. The overall color palette is composed of various shades of brown, suggesting wood and metal materials, and the background is plain and off-white, with no additional objects or decoration present.
title: Coffee Grinder
